title: Calling the server from a page
summary: A page gets data from the server through a client class. Mark the class with `HTTPClient` and its methods with `GetRequest`, `PostRequest` and the other request annotations. A service gets the client with `Needs` and calls its methods. In JavaScript, TypeScript, Dart, C#, F#, Rust and Go, a client whose Setup gives it no adapter sends its request through the browser to the server of the page, without cookies; in the other languages the Setup gives the client an adapter. A request to another host needs that host in `tac.outgoing.hosts`.
